#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Install CotEditor scripts from src/ to the CotEditor Application Scripts dir
# Detects installed tool locations and substitutes them into templates.
# Requires only POSIX tools (bash, find, sed, cp, cmp, mkdir) + osascript.

set -euo pipefail

trap 'printf "${ERROR} at or near line %s:\n\t%s\n" \
    "$LINENO" "$BASH_COMMAND" >&2' ERR

trap 'cleanup; exit 130' INT
trap 'cleanup; exit 143' TERM

function cleanup() {
    stty sane
    printf "\n"
}

ERROR="\e[0;31m[Error]\e[0m"
WARNING="\e[0;33m[Warning]\e[0m"
INFO="\e[0;34m[Info]\e[0m"

# Tools whose paths get substituted into @@tool@@ tokens in src/ scripts.
# Add new tools here when introducing new helper scripts.
declare -a KNOWN_TOOLS=(
    prettier
    eslint
    gofmt
    ruff
    rustfmt
    sd
    shellcheck
    shfmt
    swiftformat
)

# Files to ignore when checking for unknown files in destination directories.
declare -a IGNORED_BASENAMES=(
    .DS_Store
)

help() {
    cat <<EOF
installScripts

Generates CotEditor helper scripts from templates in src/ by
substituting @@tool@@ tokens with the user's actual tool paths
(detected via command -v), then copies them into the CotEditor
Application Scripts directory.

Files are routed automatically based on filename:
    - Numbered files (starting with a digit) go to the scripts directory
      and appear in the CotEditor Script menu
    - Non-numbered files go to the _lib/ subdirectory and are hidden from
      the menu — these are helper scripts called by the numbered scripts

BEHAVIOR:
    - Generates Scripts/ from src/ as a build artifact (gitignored)
    - Copies files from Scripts/ to the CotEditor scripts directory
    - Only copies new or changed files (skips identical files)
    - Skips helper scripts whose required tools are not installed
    - Warns about unknown files in the CotEditor directory
    - Warns if the CotEditor scripts directory does not exist

USAGE:
    ./installScripts [OPTIONS]

OPTIONS:
    -h, --help      Show this help message and exit
    -d, --dry-run   Preview actions without making changes
    -v, --verbose   Show all actions including skipped files

EXAMPLES:
    ./installScripts
    ./installScripts --dry-run --verbose

EOF
}

DRY_RUN=false
VERBOSE=false
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case $1 in
    -h | --help)

BUILDDIR="$REPODIR/Scripts"

    exit 1

# Parallel arrays keep bash 3.2 compatibility (no associative arrays).
declare -a TOOL_NAMES=()
declare -a TOOL_PATHS=()

printf "==> Detected tools:\n"
for tool in "${KNOWN_TOOLS[@]}"; do
    path="$(command -v "$tool" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    TOOL_NAMES+=("$tool")
    TOOL_PATHS+=("$path")
    if [[ -n $path ]]; then
        printf "    %-13s %s\n" "$tool" "$path"

        printf "    %-13s ${WARNING} not found — helpers that need it will be skipped\n" "$tool"
    fi

        sed_args+=(-e "s|@@${tool}@@|${path}|g")
    done

    else
        sed "${sed_args[@]}" "$src" >"$dest"
    fi

printf "The CotEditor scripts directory is:\n"

    "$LINENO" "$BASH_COMMAND" >&2' ERR
trap 'cleanup; exit 130' INT
trap 'cleanup; exit 143' TERM

function cleanup() {
    stty sane
    printf "\n"
}

# --- Color and Status Codes from installScripts ---
ERROR="\e[0;31m[Error]\e[0m"
WARNING="\e[0;33m[Warning]\e[0m"
INFO="\e[0;34m[Info]\e[0m"

# --- Flag Parsing from installScripts ---
DRY_RUN=false
VERBOSE=false
NEW_SYSTEM_NAME="${DEFAULT_NEW_SYSTEM_NAME}" # Defaulting here

        ;;
    -d | --dry-run)
        DRY_RUN=true
        shift
        ;;
    -v | --verbose)

    *)

        if [[ $# -eq 1 ]]; then
            NEW_SYSTEM_NAME="$1"

            # This is likely the NEW_SYSTEM_NAME positional argument.
            NEW_SYSTEM_NAME="$1"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Script to clone a new system from the LMS template system.
# This script is designed to be run from within the main projects directory structure.

# --- CONFIGURATION VARIABLES (Customize these) ---
AIS="/Users/monty/Projects/AI_experiments"
TEMPLATE_NAME="LMS"
DEFAULT_NEW_SYSTEM_NAME="Qwen2_5_Coder_14B"
# ----------------------------------------------------

# Trap signals for graceful exit and cleanup
trap 'printf "\n" >&2' INT TERM EXIT

# --- Color and Status Codes from installScripts ---
ERROR="\e[0;31m[Error]\e[0m"
WARNING="\e[0;33m[Warning]\e[0m"
INFO="\e[0;34m[Info]\e[0m"

# --- Flag Parsing ---
DRY_RUN=false
VERBOSE=false
NEW_SYSTEM_NAME="${DEFAULT_NEW_SYSTEM_NAME}"

# Parse flags and positional arguments
while [[ $# -gt 0 ]]; do
    case "$1" in
    -h | --help)
        echo "Usage: $0 [OPTIONS] <NEW_SYSTEM_NAME>"
        echo ""
        echo "Clones the '$TEMPLATE_NAME' system template and prepares it as '<NEW_SYSTEM_NAME>'."
        echo "Options: -d, --dry-run | -v, --verbose"
        exit 0
        ;;
    -d | --dry-run)
        DRY_RUN=true
        shift
        ;;
    -v | --verbose)
        VERBOSE=true
        shift
        ;;
    *)
        NEW_SYSTEM_NAME="$1"
        shift
    esac
done

# --- Validation Checks ---
if [[ -z "$NEW_SYSTEM_NAME" ]]; then
    printf "${ERROR} Fatal: NEW_SYSTEM_NAME is not set. Use -d or provide a name.\n" >&2
    exit 1
fi


# --- Core Logic Functions ---

main() {
    if [[ $DRY_RUN == true ]]; then
        echo -e "\n\e[0;33m=======================================\n" >&2
        echo "INFO: Starting DRY RUN mode. No changes will be made to the filesystem.\n" >&2
        echo "TARGET SYSTEM: ${NEW_SYSTEM_NAME}\n" >&2
        echo "=======================================\n\n" >&2
    fi

    # 1. Navigate and Clone
    printf "${INFO}==> Navigating to AIS directory (%s)...\n" "$AIS"
    cd "$AIS" || {
        printf "${ERROR} Failed to change directory to %s\n" "$AIS" >&2
        exit 1
    }

    if [ "$VERBOSE" = true ]; then
        printf "${INFO}Attempting to clone template system '%s' into new directory '%s'...\n" "$TEMPLATE_NAME" "$NEW_SYSTEM_NAME"
    fi

    if [ "$DRY_RUN" = false ]; then
        printf "${INFO}==> Cloning template system '%s' into '%s'...\n" "$TEMPLATE_NAME" "$NEW_SYSTEM_NAME"
        cp -Rp "$TEMPLATE_NAME" "$NEW_SYSTEM_NAME" || {
            printf "${ERROR} Failed to clone template system. Check permissions and source path.\n" >&2
            exit 1
        }
    else
        echo "--- DRY RUN: Would clone '${TEMPLATE_NAME}' into '${NEW_SYSTEM_NAME}'. ---"
    fi


    # 2. Move and Rename Files
    printf "${INFO}==> Renaming system files in %s...\n" "$NEW_SYSTEM_NAME"

    if [ "$DRY_RUN" = false ]; then
        # Actual execution block
        mv hidden/LMS_AGENTS.md "${NEW_SYSTEM_NAME}/hidden/Qwen2_5_Coder_14B_AGENTS.md" 2>/dev/null || :
        mv hidden/LMS_TOOLS.md "${NEW_SYSTEM_NAME}/hidden/Qwen2_5_Coder_14B_TOOLS.md" 2>/dev/null || :
        mv hidden/LMS_MCP.json "${NEW_SYSTEM_NAME}/hidden/Qwen2_5_Coder_14B_MCP.json" 2>/dev/null || :
    else
        # Simulation block for Dry Run success feedback
        echo "--- DRY RUN: Would move LMS templates into '${NEW_SYSTEM_NAME}'. ---"
    fi

    # 3. Search and Indexing (Conditional Execution)
    printf "${INFO}==> Running initial repository scan on LMS template...\n"
    if [ "$DRY_RUN" = false ]; then
        rg -N --sort path -c "${TEMPLATE_NAME}" "*" || { printf "${WARNING} rg command failed on template.\n" >&2; }
    else
        echo "--- DRY RUN: Would run repository scan on LMS template. ---"
    fi

    printf "${INFO}==> Running initial repository scan on new system (%s)...\n" "$NEW_SYSTEM_NAME"
    if [ "$DRY_RUN" = false ]; then
        sd "${TEMPLATE_NAME}" "${NEW_SYSTEM_NAME}" -- */*/* || :
    else
        echo "--- DRY RUN: Would run repository scan on new system (${NEW_SYSTEM_NAME}). ---"
    fi


    # 4. Finalization
    printf "${INFO}==> Copying new MCP file to scaffolding area...\n"

    if [ "$DRY_RUN" = false ]; then
        cp -Rp "${NEW_SYSTEM_NAME}/hidden/Qwen2_5_Coder_14B_MCP.json" "$AIS/Scaffolding/MCP" || {
             printf "${ERROR} Failed to copy final MCP file.\n" >&2
        }
    else
        echo "--- DRY RUN: Would copy new MCP file to scaffolding area. ---"
    fi

    printf "\n\e[0;32m=======================================\n" >&2
    printf "SUCCESS: Build successful. System '%s' is ready.\n" "$NEW_SYSTEM_NAME" >&2
    printf "=======================================\n\n" >&2
}

# --- Execution Start ---
main "$@"

# For this scenario, we assume:

# Argument Parsing (Robust Check)
if [ "$#" -lt 1 ]; then
    printf "${ERROR} Fatal: Missing arguments. Usage: $0 [-d] [NEW_SYSTEM_NAME]\n" >&2
    exit 1
fi

DRY_RUN=false
NEW_SYSTEM_NAME=""

while getopts "d:v" opt; do
    case $opt in
        d) 
            DRY_RUN=true # The '-d' flag indicates Dry Run mode.
            ;;
        v) 
            VERBOSE=true # The '-v' flag enables verbose output.
            ;;
        *)
            printf "${ERROR} Invalid option -$OPTARG\n" >&2
            exit 1
            ;;
    esac
done
shift $((OPTIND - 1))

# Capture the positional argument as the Target System Name
if [ "$#" -gt 0 ]; then
    NEW_SYSTEM_NAME="$1"
fi

# --- Validation Checks ---
if [[ -z "$NEW_SYSTEM_NAME" ]]; then
    printf "${ERROR} Fatal: NEW_SYSTEM_NAME is not set. Use -d or provide a name.\n" >&2
    exit 1
fi


# --- Core Logic Functions ---

main() {
    if [[ $DRY_RUN == true ]]; then
        echo -e "\n\e[0;33m=======================================\n" >&2
        echo "INFO: Starting DRY RUN mode. No changes will be made to the filesystem.\n" >&2
        echo "TARGET SYSTEM: ${NEW_SYSTEM_NAME}\n" >&2
        echo "=======================================\n\n" >&2
    fi

    # Use full, absolute paths to prevent CWD ambiguity.
    AIS_PATH="${AIS}"
    TEMPLATE_SRC="${AIS_PATH}/${TEMPLATE_NAME}"
    NEW_SYSTEM_DST="${AIS_PATH}/${NEW_SYSTEM_NAME}"

    # 1. Navigate and Clone
    printf "${INFO}==> Navigating to AIS directory (%s)...\n" "$AIS_PATH"
    cd "$AIS_PATH" || {
        printf "${ERROR} Failed to change directory to %s\n" "$AIS_PATH" >&2
        exit 1
    }

    if [ "$VERBOSE" = true ]; then
        printf "${INFO}Attempting to clone template system '%s' into new directory '%s'...\n" "$TEMPLATE_NAME" "$NEW_SYSTEM_NAME"

    if [ "$DRY_RUN" = false ]; then

        # Critical fix: Using full paths for copy operation.
        cp -Rp "$TEMPLATE_SRC" "$NEW_SYSTEM_DST" || {
            printf "${ERROR} Failed to clone template system from %s to %s. Check permissions and source path.\n" "$TEMPLATE_SRC" "$NEW_SYSTEM_DST" >&2
            exit 1
        }
    else
        echo "--- DRY RUN: Would clone '${TEMPLATE_SRC}' into '${NEW_SYSTEM_DST}'. ---"
    fi


    # 2. Move and Rename Files (Crucial to use absolute paths here too)
    printf "${INFO}==> Renaming system files in %s...\n" "$NEW_SYSTEM_NAME"

    if [ "$DRY_RUN" = false ]; then
        # Use the full path for the destination to be safe.
        mv hidden/LMS_AGENTS.md "${NEW_SYSTEM_NAME}/hidden/Qwen2_5_Coder_14B_AGENTS.md" 2>/dev/null || :

    else
        echo "--- DRY RUN: Would move LMS templates into '${NEW_SYSTEM_NAME}'. ---"
    fi

    # 3. Search and Indexing (Conditional Execution)
    printf "${INFO}==> Running initial repository scan on LMS template...\n"
    if [ "$DRY_RUN" = false ]; then
        rg -N --sort path -c "${TEMPLATE_NAME}" "*" || { printf "${WARNING} rg command failed on template.\n" >&2; }
    else
        echo "--- DRY RUN: Would run repository scan on LMS template. ---"
    fi

    printf "${INFO}==> Running initial repository scan on new system (%s)...\n" "$NEW_SYSTEM_NAME"
    if [ "$DRY_RUN" = false ]; then
        sd "${TEMPLATE_NAME}" "${NEW_SYSTEM_NAME}" -- */*/* || :
    else
        echo "--- DRY RUN: Would run repository scan on new system (${NEW_SYSTEM_NAME}). ---"
    fi


    # 4. Finalization
    printf "${INFO}==> Copying new MCP file to scaffolding area...\n"

    if [ "$DRY_RUN" = false ]; then
        # Again, ensure full paths are used here.
        cp -Rp "${NEW_SYSTEM_NAME}/hidden/Qwen2_5_Coder_14B_MCP.json" "${AIS}/Scaffolding/MCP" || {
             printf "${ERROR} Failed to copy final MCP file.\n" >&2
        }
    else
        echo "--- DRY RUN: Would copy new MCP file to scaffolding area. ---"
    fi

    printf "\n\e[0;32m=======================================\n" >&2
    printf "SUCCESS: Build successful. System '%s' is ready.\n" "$NEW_SYSTEM_NAME" >&2
    printf "=======================================\n\n" >&2
}

# --- Execution Start ---
main "$@"
